facts.fact: 饭桌开场：Eloise 骂 Billie 闭嘴、命令她去洗碗——过去线家暴日常的第一幕。
facts.anchor: “Billie—just shut the fuck up. No one wants to hear you blab your mouth. Go start the dishes,” Eloise scolds, tossing her head toward the tower of dishes that fill the sink.

facts.fact: 父亲在旁一言不发，只对她耸肩——眼神里没有任何想法。
facts.anchor: He shrugs at me, no thoughts reaching his eyes.

facts.fact: Sean 发短信约她 7:37pm 在高中见面，说有个好玩的点子。
facts.anchor: Meet me at the high school. I have a fun idea. 7:37pm

facts.fact: Eloise 两夜前的暴骂：自称「救」了 Billie 不变成她生母那样的吸毒者，骂她 selfish bitch。
facts.anchor: I saved you from a life of becoming a nobody drug-addict just like your mother. You’re such a selfish bitch.

facts.fact: 她用「Rosie 请她去学新钢琴曲」的谎话骗出门。
facts.anchor: I forgot she asked me to come over and help her with a new song she’s learning on the piano.

facts.fact: 看台上 Sean 正式告白；Billie 回了 I like you too。
告白后 Sean 交底自己要走了（去军队），说要不要告诉她他犹豫过。
facts.anchor: I really debated whether to tell you or not.

facts.fact: 派对出门前 Eloise 骂她穿新买的 crop top 像 whore、自讨没趣。
facts.anchor: Not after Eloise said I looked like a whore and was asking for it.

facts.fact: 舞池里 Sean 凑在她耳边说 With you it is，双手锁在她背脊上。
facts.anchor: he says, his lips brushing against my ear and his hands locked on my spine.

facts.fact: 办公室里 Sean 拒绝酒后亲吻，但承诺：总有一天会亲她、会更进一步。
